ops-bot: Paging: elevated error rate on /inference/v1 across eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Primary oncall for 21:00-05:00 UTC please ACK. Potential customer impact reported by telemetry. Incident tracker: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0423 :rotating_light:

alex kim: ack. i'm scheduled primary tonight but need to request a swap — family emergency came up. can someone pick up primary 21:00-05:00 (or at least cover the heavier overnight segment)? i can take secondary tomorrow morning. sorry for the late ask.

maria chen: i can pick up from 21:30-01:30 but i have a hard calendar block 01:30-03:00 (doctor). @jordan park can you cover 01:30-05:00? if not i can do 03:00-05:00 but would prefer not to wake up at 02:45. also need a quick summary of what's active now.

jordan park: i can take 01:30-05:00 as primary. confirm i'm ok with the handoff. what's the current customer impact? any ongoing mitigations?

incident-bot: Active alerts summary for INC-2026-0423:
- 21:12 UTC: 5xx spike on /inference/v1 (p95 latency 430ms -> 900ms, errors 2.8% -> 9.6%)
- Affected tenants: 3 high-usage customers, several trial apps reporting timeouts
- Recent deploy? last stable deploy 2026-04-22 03:12 UTC (no rollouts since)
- Suggested runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/api-throttling-incident

alex kim: quick notes before i hand off:
- root cause suspected: KV cache pressure + one model variant experiencing OOMs on host pool-3
- temp mitigation applied: reduced batch size for model-rank-v2 and enabled fallback route to model-rank-v1 (see below).
- commands i used:```bash
# switch fallback route to v1
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \
  https://controlplane.internal/routes/fallback -d '{"service":"inference","route":"model-rank-v1"}'
# temp scale-up pool-3
kubectl scale deployment pool-3 --replicas=6 -n inference
```
- i'll leave the current logs tail open in nyx: `nyx tail service=inference filter=OOM`

maria chen: thanks alex — that helps. i'll start by verifying the fallback route is stable and watch KV hit ratio. important runbooks: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff and the throttling doc above. i'll also unmute tracing for the affected tenant ids.

jordan park: plan for my slot (01:30-05:00):
- 01:30: confirm pool health, check OOMs, confirm fallback still serving
- 02:00: if errors > 5% for 10m, enable additional fallback: `model-rank-quant` and reduce max_tokens to 512 globally for affected routes
- 03:00: run async cache warm if KV miss rate > 20%: `python tools/cache_warm.py --tenants 123,456`
- escalate to eng-runtime on-call if host OOMs persist after scale-up (pager: +1 555 010 203)

maria chen: i confirmed fallback route is active and the KV miss rate is 18% trending down after the scale. currently CPU on pool-3 at 78%, mem spiking intermittently to 92% on one node (that's the OOM suspect). i've pinned the suspect host for repro: host-3b. i'll add a short note in the incident tracker.

alex kim: thanks. i've updated the rota in the oncall sheet — swap request submitted. @ops-bot can you record the handoff and update the schedule?

ops-bot: oncall rota updated: new primary coverage tonight:
- 21:30-01:30 => maria chen (primary)
- 01:30-05:00 => jordan park (primary)
alex kim => secondary (on-call standby)
Swap logged: https://redwood.internal/oncall/rotations/2026-04

jordan park: acked and noted. i'll take over monitoring at 01:30 and will post any escalation into this thread. if i need to flip fallback to `model-rank-quant` i'll call for eng-runtime.

maria chen: leaving a short handoff bullet list in the incident: latency metric in datadog dashboard `inference.api.latency.p95`, tail logs on nyx for `OOM`, and my local troubleshooting notes in the tracker.

alex kim: appreciate everyone stepping in. sorry again for the scramble — i should be back on baseline tomorrow morning.

incident-bot: Note: customer-impact update required before EOD. please add a short summary of affected tenants and SLA risk to INC-2026-0423.

maria chen: will add customer-impact note now. adding tenants A123, B789, C456 and that we applied fallback and scaled pool-3; risk of degraded p95 until autoscale finishes (~15-25m).

jordan park: added my acceptance note and mitigation plan. will post another status at 02:15 UTC.

ops-bot: closing action: rota and handoff recorded, incident tracking link pinned. if primary needs further swaps, update this thread so ops-bot can log it. good luck and thanks :heart:
